# Regression fixture provenance

cycle115_ingested.sql was generated through the unchanged Cycle 115 API.
cycle120_renewed.sql was generated through unchanged Cycle 120 APIs, including a
committed renewed candidate. cycle127_checkpoint.zip was generated through unchanged
Cycle 127 checkpoint APIs from a fixture-only ResearchState and example.org payload.
They contain artificial regression data, not live research or authenticated human
approval. They allow testing older storage formats without older source directories.

Cycle 133 compatibility fixture: cycle132_double_diamond_checkpoint.zip is an unmodified
checkpoint generated by the actual Cycle 132 dd_demo learning-loop run, before Cycle 133
changes. It contains synthetic research, simulated approvals, seven visits and saved
version 2 reports. Restoring it tests original journal replay and report hashes; it is
not a new checkpoint constructed through the code under test.

Cycle 134 compatibility fixture: cycle133_criteria_checkpoint.zip is an unmodified
checkpoint from the saved Cycle 133 criteria_demo run. It retains original version 3
criterion-linked reports and journal hashes, with no research_agendas field. It tests
historical replay rather than regenerating history through the new code.
